story.heading: Our Story
paragraphs: BC Glass and Tint was established in 1994 and is a family-owned and operated business. We have been tinting windows in Boulder City and across Southern Nevada for over 30 years. We are professional installers, and we stand behind every installation. Satisfaction guaranteed. It is written across our logo, and it has been there since 1994. The film carries a manufacturer warranty you sign for. On the install, if anything is not right, tell us and we take care of it.

From auto, residential and commercial window film to windshields, clear bra, ceramic coating and blinds, our mission is simple: help you reach your tint and glass goals with computer-cut precision and film backed by a lifetime manufacturer warranty. As a proud local Boulder City business, that commitment has earned us {google_count} Google reviews and a {google_rating} rating, and kept us family-owned the whole way.
